timing.start_boundary: Conservative estimated 11:00:00 UTC budget origin; exact first action unmeasured. First clock observation 11:00:37 UTC followed initial reads.

infrastructure_pauses.reason: Platform usage interruption; last completed command to first resumed clock observation; excluded from active time.

timing.tool_seconds_scope: Cumulative subprocess wall seconds measured by run.py, including generator, CLI and report-reading commands; concurrent command durations may overlap. Not total elapsed time.
timing.uninstrumented_time: Tool overhead, initial reads, other read-only shell inspection, editing, image opening, reasoning and final result bookkeeping were not individually measured; they are included in estimated active wall time. No durations are fabricated for those operations.

repair_cycle_definition: Failed manual evidence review followed by model source correction, even when the selected CLI checks returned exit 0.

repairs.finding: The conveyor lower rails were half a stud off the base stud rows; full inspection showed a separate 33-part rigid conveyor group.
repairs.correction: Translate every conveyor rigid placement except the mounted base by +10 LDU in Z; chain follows wheels; add two eight-stud base-to-rail required joints.
repairs.result: Final full contact report has one 143-part rigid group, 24 chain-link groups and three hose groups.

features.braced_supporting_frame: Two box-chassis trestles; preserved fixed-structure contracts pass.
features.attached_workbench: Bonded two-course System bench, retained pin-to-frame and pin-to-deck joint checks.
features.supported_retained_shafts: Two bearings per shaft; 10L drive, 8L idler; contiguous spacer/stops and retention checks; 120 LDU wheel spacing unchanged.
features.compatible_chain: 24 synthesized 3711 links around two supported 4019 wheels; final home/top close-up images inspected.
features.hand_crank: Keyed thin crank with retained handle axle and accessible external grip.
features.pneumatic_stop: Mounted 74981-f2 extended cylinder with 116 LDU eye separation and pinned stop face; mounted pump and valve.
features.three_hose_circuit: Pump outlet to valve inlet; valve upper to cylinder base; valve lower to cylinder rod; actual hose checks retained and passed.
features.custom_bodywork: Dark-blue System guard/bodywork, orange accents, new mounted side guards and safety tiles with explicit attachment checks.
features.contextual_images: Final home, front, rear (back), top and underside (bottom) opened, plus final chain home and top.
features.reproducible_editable_source: generate.py and ordinary machine.plan.json; embedded final-review/model.mpd.

limitations: One extended static pose only. No verified motion, pressure circuit simulation, transport performance, strength, stability, chain tension, changing hose slack or physical buildability.
Finite sampled hose geometry is not a manufactured hose-length or full material-intersection proof.
Chain closure and tooth engagement were visually inspected; no analytical closure or dynamic engagement certification exists.
Final disconnected-evidence warning corresponds to 24 synthesized chain links and three hoses outside one connected 143-part rigid group.
Unknown Technic structural taxonomy remains for the chain links and valve; actual valve mount and named hose endpoints have separate checks.
Six hose obstacle bounds candidates are fitting endpoint regions; sleeves inspected in context. Conservative bounds include voids, so general collision freedom is not certified.
Inherited 3023 valve pad is an inspected alias resolving to 3023b, with geometry and connector metadata complete; preserved in matching BOMs.
Real commercial part/colour availability and physical insertion swept paths are not certified.
Timing origin and infrastructure pause boundaries are estimated; individually unmeasured tool time is explicitly not reported as measured.
